description: Class representing a single icon criterion.

GetIcon.description: Returns the icon associated with the current icon criterion.

returns.description: The icon constant, or null if not available.

GetIndex.description: Returns the index of the icon criterion in the collection.

returns.description: The 1-based index of the icon criterion.

GetOperator.description: Returns the comparison operator of the icon criterion.

returns.description: The operator ("xlGreaterEqual" or "xlGreater"), or null if not available.

GetType.description: Returns the condition value type for the icon criterion.

returns.description: The condition value type, or null if not available.

GetValue.description: Returns the threshold value for the icon criterion.

returns.description: The threshold value, or null if not available.

SetIcon.description: Sets the icon for the current icon criterion.

SetOperator.description: Sets the comparison operator for the icon criterion.

SetType.description: Sets the condition value type for the icon criterion.

params.description: The condition value type. Only "xlConditionValueNumber", "xlConditionValuePercent", "xlConditionValuePercentile", or "xlConditionValueFormula" are supported.
params.name: type

SetValue.description: Sets the threshold value for the icon criterion.
